decisions.reason: As a product line closely linked to the firm's core formwork and plant-engineering know-how, it fits existing absorptive capacity well and is likely to remain part of the portfolio.
This shuttering magnet block is closely related to the firm's established modular formwork business, so the firm can readily refine and support it with its existing engineering and R&D capabilities.

Because this magnetic formwork component was given dedicated presentation and lies near the firm's core competencies, management would likely keep and incrementally improve it rather than withdraw it.
Although it appears somewhat less prominently positioned than the main product lines, it still builds on familiar magnetic formwork knowledge and is therefore more likely to be retained than dropped.
